verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own product page claims built-in AI: chat, search, an AI code reviewer that suggests fixes, and AI-powered workflows that handle tasks like cleaning up feature flags, updating docs, drafting release notes and fixing flaky tests. These are short marketing claims only. Task delegation is shown mainly through pipeline-triggered workflows, not through an interactive assistant you hand tasks to inside the UI. missing for 10: detailed docs on delegating tasks to the in-product chat assistant, its scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Trigger AI-powered workflows to automate tedious tasks: clean up feature flags, update docs, draft release notes, fix flaky tests, and more — all from your pipeline.
Reduce cycle times across the development lifecycle with AI-powered search, chat, code review, pipeline triage, and even Jira updates.
Our AI code reviewer reviews all code changes and suggests fixes so you can merge faster.
